content:
In this session, the results of the Capacity-Building Action Cycle on Contaminated Soils and Rocks will be presented, along with the media kit developed under the project, as well as the conclusions on the relevance of the topic and this type of initiative.

⏰ 3:00pm – 4:00pm   📌 Register here!

These events take place following the protocol BUILT CoLAB established with APA and the Fundo Ambiental under the "Soil Quality Assessment" project, and aimed to raise awareness among the various stakeholders about soil quality assessment, risk analysis and sustainable soil remediation processes, thereby contributing to the prevention and combating of soil pollution.

Full information here.
